meta.position_scope: WR only. Every other position is excluded from the product but remains in the team denominators, so target share means share of ALL of a team's targets.
meta.inclusion_rule: >= 8 games in the window, OR on a current 2026 WR roster / priced by the current receiving market

count_rules.target: a pass attempt, excluding two-point tries, carrying a source-supplied receiver id. Never inferred from play text.
count_rules.target_share: player targets over that team's targets in the same game; both numbers are retained
count_rules.receiving_yards: null on an incompletion by construction, so per-game totals sum only over completions
count_rules.red_zone_target: a target on a play whose source-supplied yardline is inside the opponent twenty. Field position is present on 100% of targeted plays, measured.

withheld_fields.reason: coverage is ~37% for 2019-2022, 100% for 2023, and the participation file is NOT PUBLISHED for 2024-2025. A route metric on that would describe whichever plays were charted.
requires the same participation file; withheld for the same reason
